schema.description: Measured-usage query. user_id and agent_id filters select the scope; there is no target field. Structural principal acceptance does not grant permission; forbidden personal requests return 403.

time_range.description: UTC midnight bounds, with an exclusive end. Search requires an explicit range because an implicit default would hide an expensive warehouse scan.

start.description: Inclusive UTC midnight boundary, no earlier than midnight of the UTC day that contains the request time minus 90 days.

end.description: Exclusive UTC midnight boundary, strictly after start.

allOf.description: Filter results to those last updated within this range.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound in ISO 8601 format.

end.description: Exclusive upper bound in ISO 8601 format.

allOf.title: PlatformTimeRange

time_range.title: PlatformUsageSearchTimeRange

group_by.description: Up to five unique dimensions, at most one principal dimension; principals require the admin route.

items.description: Grouping key, named for the response dimension it fills (MODEL_ID fills model_id). USER_ID is admin-only. DEPARTMENT_NAME and GROUP_ID are admin-only and deferred. Their well-formed personal requests return 403, not 400.
items.title: PlatformUsageDimension

filters.description: Filters AND together; values within each filter OR together.

items.description: Exact, case-sensitive filter. Values OR together; filters AND together. Null cannot be selected.

field.description: Allowlist is product, feature, model_id, client_id, agent_id, user_id, department_name, group_id. Unknown names return invalid_filter. user_id and agent_id also select the scope (see the operation); department_name and group_id are admin-only and deferred.

values.description: Nonblank exact values with no trimming. client_id follows Usage limit target client_id validation: empty, whitespace-only, control, and synthetic IDs are invalid; unknown IDs are valid. PRODUCT and FEATURE match normalized taxonomy.

operator.description: EQUALS (default) or NOT_EQUALS only; range operators are invalid.

items.title: PlatformUsageSearchFilter

metrics.description: USED is always returned; EVENT_COUNT sums raw billing events in both units.

sort.description: When omitted, defaults to PERIOD_START ASC for time series, otherwise USED DESC. When supplied, field and direction are both required.

direction.description: Sort direction; required whenever sort is supplied.

unit.description: Valid only with USED; omission compares USD first, then CREDITS.
unit.title: PlatformUsageUnit

sort.title: PlatformUsageSearchSort

include.description: Add page-only visible labels or the complete-query bucket count.

page_size.description: Maximum buckets per page; defaults to 100, maximum 1,000.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior page. Resend the same query and page size; it is bound to the route, caller, tenant, filter-derived scope, and snapshot. Missing retained state or a snapshot older than 24 hours is expired_cursor.

schema.title: PlatformSearchCallerUsageRequest
